common_instruction: Use the stated context; explain concrete behavior and do not claim tests were run without evidence.

cases.name: Struct copy aliasing
cases.prompt: A Go struct contains a map[string]int, a []byte and an int. A developer copies it with b := a, edits b.Map and b.Slice[0], and expects a unchanged. What does this copy guarantee?
cases.trap: Calls a struct value copy a deep copy and misses shared referenced data.
expectations: Distinguishes field-by-field value copy from cloning nested map/slice storage.
States which modifications can affect a and how to clone the mutable fields when independence is required.
must_not: Does not claim b := a deep-clones maps and slice backing arrays.
